meta_description: T.L.Coole Decorating Services in Bristol. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and full decorating. Free quotes, professional finish guaranteed.
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior work done right, on time, and without the mess. Free quotes for Bristol homeowners.
services_subhead: From full room redecoration to specialist finishes, we handle residential and commercial projects with meticulous attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decoration
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, and woodwork refreshed to a professional standard. We prepare surfaces properly and use quality paints for a finish that lasts.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior work including fascias, soffits, and cladding. We protect your Bristol home from the elements with durable, long-lasting colour.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Hanging, pattern-matching, and removal of old wallpaper. We specialise in tricky corners and period properties across Bristol.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Create impact with bold colours or textured finishes. Our colour advice helps you avoid costly mistakes before the brush touches the wall.

services.title: Furniture Painting & Upcycling
services.desc: Transform tired cupboards, doors, and bespoke pieces with specialist paint techniques. Perfect for refreshing kitchens and period features.

services.title: Commercial & New Build Decoration
services.desc: Office spaces, rental properties, and new builds completed on schedule. We work flexibly to fit your project timeline and budget.

about_pullquote: I started this because I couldn't stand rushed work and hidden costs.
about_para_1: T.L.Coole Decorating Services has been transforming homes and businesses across Bristol for over 15 years. Founded on a simple belief—that good decorating should be honest, timely, and affordable—we've built our reputation one job at a time. Every project, from a small bedroom to a full commercial refurbishment, receives the same care and attention.
about_para_2: Our customers choose us for our straightforward approach: no surprises, no pressure, and work we're genuinely proud of. We show up on time, clean up properly, and leave you with a finish that makes you want to invite people round. Many of our clients have come back for repeat work across their homes, and we're always happy to provide references.

reviews.text: Had the living room and hallway done. Terry arrived when he said he would, kept the place clean as he worked, and the finish is brilliant. Exactly what I wanted, no faffing about. Definitely using him again for the upstairs.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Quoted us for exterior work on a Victorian terrace—really knew what he was talking about. Didn't try to upsell us on things we didn't need. Finished ahead of schedule and the colour looks fantastic. Would recommend to anyone in Bristol.
reviews.author: Claire W.

reviews.text: Small job, big difference. Changed two feature walls and new skirting. Terry is professional, friendly, and his attention to detail is spot on. Fair pricing too. Already got him booked in for next year.
reviews.author: David H.
